title: The canonical completed comparison E→F×_Spec(A)Spec C is an isomorphism.
statement: Let A be a Noetherian local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], U an open of Spec A consisting exactly of the points other than its closed point [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], q:Y→U and s:E→Spec C finite morphisms [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], where C is the maximal-ideal completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Let D be an overlap identification and let B, F, r and the canonical comparisons be the explicit matching-sections constructions [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. The canonical completed comparison E→F×_Spec(A)Spec C is an isomorphism. This asserts no finiteness or other comparison property of the candidate.

proof.text: Construct the ring pushout comparison. Injectivity and surjectivity give a bijective ring map and hence a CommRingCat isomorphism. Finite s over an affine base makes E affine. Mathlib isPullback_SpecMap_pushout identifies the spectrum of the ring pushout with the model base change. Checking both projections by pushout.inl_desc, pushout.inr_desc, naturality of toSpecΓ and the affine counit proves that E.toSpecΓ followed by Spec of the comparison and the canonical pullback isomorphism equals D.completedMap. All three factors are isomorphisms.
